verdict.reasons: Clear failure against the required evidence: the scene lacks the closed ribbed compression union installed inline between two continuous black irrigation pipes; no joined ends/seal are visible and the foreground black line is a continuous unbroken pipe without any inline connector. This core mismatch blocks pass even though product identity (single white-and-blue AFP drip-tape carton), branding readability, watermark, count, framing, and topic are acceptable. Minor advisory notes: some fine sublogos/small secondary print are soft, but main AFP logo and package identity are authentic and readable; the white ribbon/strap detail is a minor packaging artifact, not a replacement for plumbing. No mixed hose family, no wrong commercial roll, no people, no impossible geometry, no collage.
